title: nan
authors: Mostafa M.M.; Moussa A.M.; El-Sheimy N.; Sesay A.B.
key_contribution: Presents a hybrid vision-aided inertial navigation system (VAINS) combining optical flow monocular VO, Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) error modeling, and EKF fusion during GNSS outages.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
